objs.name: document
objs.description: Core artifact representing a policy, guideline, instruction or other document managed in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References to other documents or information; maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Master data attribute linking to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational units relevant to the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational areas where the document is valid.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Readers who have view permissions for the document and dependent objects.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Primary author(s) of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional authors with editing rights; not necessarily signing in release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Individuals responsible for technical and formal checks during review.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Individuals responsible for releasing the document.

attributes.name: creator
attributes.description: Initial creator of the document; can be changed.

attributes.name: distribution_list
attributes.description: List of groups or users for distribution and acknowledgement.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of document (e.g., policy, guideline, work instruction).

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Document template(s) used for this document type.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version identifier; part of versioning and revision.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the workflow (e.g., editing, released).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope(s) associated with the document; used by TAG technology.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A document attachment that is linked to a parent document; treated as a separate controlled object.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Parent document to which this attachment belongs.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information added to a document.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Parent document.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Additional equipment attached to a document; subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Parent document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changes to a document; managed within the document cockpit.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Underlying document this change proposal refers to.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal.

attributes.name: proposer
attributes.description: Author who created the change proposal.

attributes.name: change_content
attributes.description: Text describing the proposed changes.
